title: YourMondayMotivator: Weddings, Anniversaries and Weather
html: Yesterday saw the wedding of Lauren's cousin go off without a hitch as Auckland put on one of its finest days. Weddings are generally a great time. Families get bonded together, fathers make heartfelt speeches, and mothers get to bask in the glory of a job very, very well done. Today however is a little bit more special than even that. It's our second wedding anniversary and what an awesome day it is. Exactly like the day we got married. The UK traditional symbol for your second anniversary is paper. Not much to go on with that I thought but I learned a new skill to through it - Origami. Bit of a mish mash of things this morning and I'm in a huge hurry to get out the door. So excuse any spelling or grammatical mistakes and have a great week. Remember though it's not only at weddings or on anniversaries you should say nice things or go to some effort for your loved ones. It doesn't take much. A smile might do. But do something, it will pay off in spades. My best. Glenn
